name: Data Science
description: From statistics and pandas to end-to-end projects — the complete foundation for turning raw data into decisions.

items.title: Kaggle Learn — Data Science
items.description: Hands-on micro-courses covering pandas, EDA and modeling.

items.title: Python for Data Analysis — Wes McKinney
items.description: The definitive guide to pandas and the PyData stack.

items.title: Pandas User Guide
items.description: Official documentation for the pandas data-analysis library.

items.title: scikit-learn User Guide
items.description: Authoritative guide to the Python machine-learning toolbox.

lessons.title: What Is Data Science?
lessons.description: Define data science, understand its core disciplines, and map the roles and workflow of a modern data team.

lessons.title: The Data Science Pipeline
lessons.description: Walk through the six stages of a data science project and learn where real projects fail — and why iteration matters.

lessons.title: Python for Data Science
lessons.description: The Python fundamentals every data scientist leans on: collections, comprehensions, file I/O, and reproducible notebooks.

lessons.title: NumPy: Arrays & Vectorization
lessons.description: Master ndarrays, broadcasting and vectorized math — the engine under every serious data workflow.

lessons.title: Pandas: DataFrames & Series
lessons.description: Load, inspect, filter, group and merge tabular data with the most important library in data science.

lessons.title: Data Cleaning & Wrangling
lessons.description: Handle missing values, duplicates, inconsistent types and outliers — the unglamorous 80% of real data work.

lessons.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
lessons.description: Systematically explore a dataset before modeling: distributions, group differences, and the questions they surface.

lessons.title: Data Visualization
lessons.description: Choose the right chart, encode data honestly, and tell a story with matplotlib and seaborn.

lessons.title: Statistics Fundamentals
lessons.description: Mean, variance, standard error, and the sampling ideas that let you reason from data to conclusions.

lessons.title: Probability Distributions
lessons.description: The distributions that show up everywhere in data work — normal, binomial, Poisson and uniform — and how to sample from them.

lessons.title: Hypothesis Testing
lessons.description: Null hypotheses, p-values, t-tests and the judgment calls that separate rigorous analysis from pattern-chasing.

lessons.title: Correlation & Causation
lessons.description: Measure association, then reason carefully about whether an intervention actually causes the effect.

lessons.title: Feature Engineering
lessons.description: Turn raw columns into features that models can actually learn from: encodings, transforms, dates and domain knowledge.

lessons.title: Train/Test Splits & Validation
lessons.description: The disciplined way to estimate model quality: hold out data, avoid leakage, and validate like it matters.

lessons.title: Regression Models
lessons.description: Predict numbers with linear and regularized regression, and read the coefficients like an analyst.

lessons.title: Classification Models
lessons.description: Predict categories with logistic regression and neighbors, and learn what decision boundaries really mean.

lessons.title: Clustering
lessons.description: Find structure without labels: k-means, distance metrics, and choosing the number of clusters honestly.

lessons.title: Model Evaluation Metrics
lessons.description: Accuracy is a trap. Learn precision, recall, F1, ROC curves, and the confusion matrix inside out.

lessons.title: Communicating Results
lessons.description: The analysis only matters if it changes decisions. Learn to write, present and defend findings clearly.

lessons.title: An End-to-End Data Science Project
lessons.description: Assemble everything into one reproducible project: ask, fetch, clean, explore, model, evaluate, and ship the notebook.

lessons.title: Beyond the Basics: Your Data Science Roadmap
lessons.description: Synthesize the course into a study roadmap, connect it to machine learning and deep learning, and plan real projects.
